newsitem.title: USA: Beckman to acquire Sanofi product group.
newsitem.headline: Beckman to acquire Sanofi product group.

text.p: Beckman Instruments Inc said Tuesday it will acquire the Access immunochemistry business of Sanofi unit Sanofi Diagnostic Pasteur, to expand its own product line in clinical laboratory testing.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
Start-up costs, interest, working capital and payments to Sanofi are expected to dilute Beckman's 1997 earnings by $0.12 to $0.15 a share, the company said.
The deal is expected to be moderately accretive in 1998 and strongly accretive afterward, Beckman said in a statement.
The acquisition is expected to close around April 30.
The acquisition represents a new immunochemisty alliance between Beckman and Sanofi Diagnostic, Beckman said.
As part of the alliance, Sanofi Diagnostic and Beckman will develop more than 40 additional Access kits for infectious disease, cancer, and protein testing.
Also, Sanofi Diagnostic will distribute Access in France and certain other markets.
Access is an integrated diagnostic system consisting of an automated instrument and 32 high-sensitivity test kits.
